summary: You bring Azuregos's ledger to Narain Soothfancy, who must decipher its writing. What he finds may bring you closer to opening the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

sections.title: The Ledger Comes to Narain
sections.body: Azuregos's ledger is in your hands, and Narain Soothfancy must decipher it. You bring the ledger to him so he can learn what Azuregos wrote.

sections.title: What Narain Makes of It
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy finds that Azuregos set you to build an arcanite buoy, and its schematic lies in the ledger. The writing is Draconic, which Narain cannot read. To make sense of it, he needs the scrying goggles, a chicken of five hundred pounds, and the second volume of Draconic for Dummies. He can gather them in any order.

faq.answer: Azuregos owns the ledger, and you bring it to Narain Soothfancy.
Narain Soothfancy must work out what Azuregos wrote in the ledger.
